title: CloudWatch Agent Missing Memory and Disk Metrics
symptom: EC2 dashboard shows CPU and network metrics, but memory and disk utilization metrics are missing.
initial_observations: Custom namespace CWAgent has no data points.
environment: EC2 instance with CloudWatch agent installed.

possible_causes.cause: EC2 instance role lacks CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy IAM permissions
possible_causes.remediation: Attach managed policy `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` to the instance's IAM role.

possible_causes.cause: CloudWatch agent service is stopped or failed due to JSON configuration syntax error
possible_causes.evidence_needed: systemctl status amazon-cloudwatch-agent shows inactive or configuration parse error.

investigation_steps.title: Check CloudWatch Agent Service Status and Logs
investigation_steps.explanation: Check if daemon is running and view recent error logs.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: status: running vs stopped; look for AccessDenied or config errors.

verification: CloudWatch Metrics console displays active data points under 'CWAgent' namespace.
prevention: Automate CloudWatch agent installation and configuration via AWS Systems Manager State Manager.
